reef-race-help: Roll, then tap each next numbered stone. Count on from your turtle. Currents move forward two or back one. Count those steps too. A shell offers a bigger-number game. You may sail past it. Share a turtle against the tide, or race each other. The tide moves two stones after each turn. There is no clock.
reef-race-roll: Roll, then tap each next stone in order.
reef-race-step: Tap the next number. Count on from your turtle.
reef-race-forward: A current! Count forward two stones.
reef-race-back: A little current. Count back one stone.
reef-race-bonus: A shell! Which number is bigger? Tap its stone, or sail past.
reef-race-bonus-try: Look along the path. The bigger number comes later. Try again, or sail past.
reef-race-skip: Sail past the shell. Time for the next turn.
reef-race-finish: A turtle reached the island. You counted all the way across the reef!
reef-race-tide-finish: The tide reached the island this time. Your team counted a long way. You can play again.
island-market-help: Welcome to the market. Hear an order, then pack it. A crate holds ten mangoes. Add or take away crates and loose mangoes. The basket tells you how many. If you have too many or too few, adjust it. For a comparison, choose who wants more. Challenge has taking away and change. Shell coins stand for one, five, ten and twenty five. Together, take turns reading an order and packing it.
island-market-order: Shopkeeper, hear the order. Choose this customer or the next one. Then pass to the packer.
island-market-pack: Packer, build the order. Each crate holds ten. Loose mangoes are ones.
island-market-change: Give change with shell coins. Their values are one, five, ten and twenty five.
island-market-under: The basket needs more. Add pieces and check again.
island-market-over: The basket has too many. Take pieces away and check again.
island-market-exact: That is the amount. The order is ready to serve.
island-market-compare-try: More means a bigger amount. Look at the tens, then the ones. Try again.
island-market-served: Thank you! The customer has the order. Meet the next customer when you are ready.
island-market-finish: All the customers have their orders. The market is ready for a rest.
island-market-coins: These are pretend shell coins for making change. You do not earn or keep them.
